prompt: Use supplied Sable Regent portrait/gameplay references for exact identity and style. Create a transparent RGBA 1536×1024 sprite sheet of eight distinct complete full-body Sable reverse-layup poses in a 4-column × 2-row grid, row-major. Same warm-brown adult human woman with recognizable face, black gathered hair/red headband, black/crimson/white Blackthorn uniform, wristbands; preserve anatomy, silhouette, scale and shoes. Right-facing start. No ball, other player, rim, props, court, floor, shadow or text; separate ball is omitted. Eight-pose reverse layup: 0 approach right; 1 gather low; 2 takeoff; 3 rise and rotate shoulders away; 4 back/three-quarter view, carry empty hand behind head; 5 clear airborne reverse release with hand reaching behind/above head toward far side; 6 unwind and descend; 7 balanced landing. Frame5 is release anchor. Complete full body and ponytail visible in every cell, no cropping. Distinct poses and correct connected human limbs. Crisp limited-palette 1990s arcade pixel art, dark outlines, no glossy/3D/painterly style. True alpha-zero background, no checkerboard/matte. Return only the sprite sheet.

ballTrack.notes: Reverse layup ball carried to the far side behind Sable’s head; frame5 is separate-ball release.

review.reviewNotes: Eight distinct full-body poses; reverse turn, overhead/behind-head finish and release at frame5 are visible; identity consistent, no ball.
